target: Violate HACKDAC_p16: trstn_pad_i must be asserted OR correct must be 0. Find a state where trstn_pad_i is deasserted while correct is non-zero (reset not operational).

milestones.description: System reset applied, JTAG TAP reset asserted
Reset released, JTAG TAP reset deasserted, correct counter initialized to zero
Password check in progress, correct counter non-zero
Violation: JTAG TAP reset asserted but correct counter is non-zero (reset does not clear correct counter)
